publications.title: Substack Publications (Handles, Substack URLs, or Custom Domains)
publications.description: List of Substack handles (e.g. 'pragmaticengineer'), Substack URLs (e.g. 'https://pragmaticengineer.substack.com'), or custom newsletter domains (e.g. 'https://newsletter.pragmaticengineer.com').

maxPostsPerPublication.title: Max Posts Per Publication
maxPostsPerPublication.description: Maximum number of newest matching posts to extract per publication.

includeFullText.title: Include Public Full Text (Markdown & Plain Text)
includeFullText.description: Merge public full-article HTML into clean body_markdown and body_text from /feed RSS or public /api/v1/posts/{slug} strictly for free (audience='everyone') posts. Paywalled posts return honest public preview text only.

onlyFree.title: Only Free / Public Posts
onlyFree.description: When enabled, skip subscriber-only/paywalled posts and return only free public (audience='everyone') articles.

publishedAfter.title: Published After (ISO Date)
publishedAfter.description: Optional ISO-8601 date or timestamp (e.g. '2026-01-01') to stop pagination once posts are older than this cutoff.

keywordFilter.title: Keyword Filter (Optional)
keywordFilter.description: Optional case-insensitive keyword filter matched against publication name, post title, subtitle, and extracted text.

requestDelayMs.title: Polite Delay Between Requests (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Polite delay in milliseconds between archive pages and public post fetches. 429/503 responses automatically trigger Retry-After backoff.
